execution_policy.reason: Phase 10 reuses the completed RF0-RF10 evidence and performs only reconciliation, power-domain contract freeze, evidence-boundary publication, and file freezing.

power_domain_contract.pd_sense: VDD_MONITORED; complete frozen FTC_SENSOR including delay/tuning network, XOR network, and sensor capture DFF
power_domain_contract.pd_ctrl: independent stable/trusted digital supply; calibration logic, M/F state, Q double sampler, future detection/margin/alarm logic
power_domain_contract.boundary: Q_FINAL after the PD_SENSE capture DFF is the SENSE-to-CTRL state crossing
power_domain_contract.mixed_signal_interface_note: Existing XA D2A/A2D elements are verification abstractions and are not evidence that physical level shifters have been implemented or signed off.

phase_0.basis: Frozen functional contract and golden trajectories.

phase_1.basis: Historical corrected transistor timing evidence retained; active controller timing is superseded by the RF7 400 MHz handoff.

phase_4.basis: Recorded FSM nominal and failure-scenario verification retained.

phase_5.basis: Recorded integrated nominal controller verification retained.

phase_7.basis: Historical 1 GHz synthesis retained for traceability; superseded as active implementation by RF8 re-frequency synthesis.

phase_8.basis: Historical gate-level functional/delayed evidence retained; RF9B provides the active 400 MHz full-timing SDF digital closure.

phase_9.basis: Corrected mixed-signal bridge evidence retained; RF9C and RF9D provide active 400 MHz three-voltage autonomous mixed-signal closure.

phase_10.basis: Active RF7/RF8/RF9D baseline reconciled, power-domain boundary frozen, cross-layer evidence boundary published, and startup-calibration frozen-file manifest created without new simulation.

historical_evidence.historical_1ghz_phase1_handoff: retained; superseded for active RTL timing consumption
historical_evidence.old_final_closure_c2_c4_1ghz_path: superseded by the completed RF0-RF10 400 MHz re-frequency closure; must not be executed as an active Phase 10 requirement

allowed: PD1 physical domain-crossing contract and level-shifter/receiver architecture
subsequent detection-margin and detection-mode work that consumes this frozen upstream baseline
forbidden_without_dedicated_change_plan: moving XOR or the sensor capture DFF out of PD_SENSE
changing the active 400 MHz calibration timing contract
changing the direct registered thermometer architecture
